label: Event Planning Team
blurb: An Event Director and 4 specialists who plan and coordinate a conference, retreat, party, or other gathering
purpose: Created for individuals, families, and organizers looking for dedicated support with event planning. Plan and coordinate a conference, retreat, party, or other gathering. The team takes care of preparation, detailed planning, and practical follow-through to keep everything running smoothly.
